LanguageData.VMF_DriverSeat.label: driver seat
LanguageData.VMF_DriverSeat.description: Driver's seat of a vehicle. When this is installed, the vehicle can be controlled.
LanguageData.VMF_GunnerSeat.label: gunner seat
LanguageData.VMF_GunnerSeat.description: Gunner's seat of a vehicle. When this is installed, the selected turret of the vehicle can be controlled.
LanguageData.VMF_PassengerSeat.label: passenger seat
LanguageData.VMF_CargoContainer.label: cargo container
LanguageData.VMF_CargoContainer.description: Storage for additional vehicle cargo capacity.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Cargo capacity:</color> +150 kg
LanguageData.VMF_TurboCharger.label: turbo charger
LanguageData.VMF_TurboCharger.description:
Engine components to enhance the vehicle's maximum payload.

<color=#bb8f04>Maximum payload:</color> +500 kg
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel Consumption:</color> +8 /day
LanguageData.VMF_LiftFan.label: lift fan
LanguageData.VMF_LiftFan.description:
A Lift fan to enhance the hover vehicle's maximum payload. Can only be installed on hover type vehicles.

<color=#bb8f04>Maximum Payload:</color> +250 kg
<color=#bb8f04>Fuel Consumption:</color> +4 /day
LanguageData.VMF_FuelTank.label: fuel tank
LanguageData.VMF_FuelTank.description: Tank for increase fuel capacity of the vehicle.\n\n<color=#bb8f04>Fuel capacity:</color> +300
LanguageData.VMF_Ladder.label: ladder
LanguageData.VMF_Ladder.description: A ladder for humans to ascend and descend on a vehicle. Pawns get priority to ascend and descend from the location where this is placed.
LanguageData.VMF_RampMedium.label: ramp (1x3)
LanguageData.VMF_RampMedium.description: A ramp for vehicles to ascend and descend to a vehicle map. Vehicles up to 3 squares wide can ascend and descend from here.
LanguageData.VMF_RampLarge.label: ramp (1x5)
LanguageData.VMF_RampLarge.description: A ramp for vehicles to ascend and descend to a vehicle map. Vehicles up to 5 squares wide can ascend and descend from here.
LanguageData.VMF_WirelessTransmitter.label: wireless power transmitter
LanguageData.VMF_WirelessTransmitter.description: A device for transmitting power between a normal map and a vehicle map.
LanguageData.VMF_WirelessReceiver.label: wireless power receiver
LanguageData.VMF_WirelessReceiver.description: A device that receives power from a normal map. It can be placed on a vehicle map and receive power by aligning with a transmitter.
LanguageData.VMF_Alternator.label: alternator
LanguageData.VMF_Alternator.description: Component that uses vehicle fuel to generate electricity.
LanguageData.VMF_PipeConnector.label: pipe connector
LanguageData.VMF_PipeConnector.description: Connection to pipe between the normal map and the vehicle map.\nPlaced on the normal map and the vehicle map, they are connected by aligning their positions.
LanguageData.VMF_Turret_ZiplineTurret.label: zipline turret
LanguageData.VMF_Turret_ZiplineTurret.description: A turret that sets up a zipline at the location where it pierces. Used for direct access between vehicles.
LanguageData.VMF_Gun_ZiplineTurret.label: zipline turret gun
LanguageData.VMF_Gun_ZiplineTurret.description: A gun made to be mounted on a zipline turret.
LanguageData.VMF_Bullet_ZiplineTurret.label: zipline turret bullet
LanguageData.VMF_Bullet_ZiplineTurretReturn.label: zipline turret bullet
LanguageData.VMF_ZiplineEnd.label: zipline end
LanguageData.VMF_VehicleStructureFilled.label: vehicle structure
LanguageData.VMF_MoteSink.label: Mote
LanguageData.VMF_GangplankAnchor.label: gangplank
LanguageData.VMF_GangplankAnchor.description: A lumber for crossing directly from one vehicle map to another.
LanguageData.VMF_GravshipWheelSmall.label: gravship wheel (1x2)
LanguageData.VMF_GravshipWheelSmall.description:
Equipment for the gravship to travel on the ground. It also serves as a thruster for movement in space, and the number of wheels affects the maximum payload and travel speed.
Only tires facing the same direction as the pilot console will be recognized.

<color=#bb8f04>Maximum payload:</color> +500 kg
<color=#bb8f04>Move speed:</color> +0.75
LanguageData.VMF_GravshipWheelLarge.label: gravship wheel (2x4)
LanguageData.VMF_GravshipWheelLarge.description:
Equipment for the gravship to travel on the ground. It also serves as a thruster for movement in space, and the number of wheels affects the maximum payload and travel speed.
Only tires facing the same direction as the pilot console will be recognized.

<color=#bb8f04>Maximum payload:</color> +2000 kg
<color=#bb8f04>Move speed:</color> +1.5
